options.instructions: Never push directly to develop or main; work only on feature branches with pull requests. Never force-push shared branches. Never edit .env files, files containing API keys, or commit secrets. Never run destructive commands (rm -rf, database migrations, schema changes) without explicit instruction. Financial values always via decimal.js, never native number. Never import spacetimedb or cloudService into core code (Local-First boundary). Never modify, delete, or clean up another agent's worktree, branch, or backlog claim.
